motion_rule: in every beat the alpaca is the subject of a whole-body move — runs, wheels, rears, hauls, shakes, hurls, stamps. She runs the belt end to end three times. Belt, goat and camera move on top of her, never instead
character: fluffy white alpaca in a yellow hard hat, long neck, buck teeth, enormous goggling eyes held wide all clip, exactly four legs; a leg behind the trolley is hidden, not replaced
cast: the GOAT foreman in a blue hard hat crosses the far side of the belt, never hiding her
props: a huge chrome trolley with a deep wire basket, half full at the start; an endless belt of battered dolls, one eye missing, seams split, each tagged with a crossed-out number; among them one rag doll overstuffed to bursting, stuffing shoving from a split belly, cracked mouth that flaps when squeezed
environment: a bright toy factory hall, glass roof, the belt running the full height of frame; blazing noon sun, hard highlights on chrome, crisp shadows
camera_moves: every beat its own move and shot size; camera always moving, tracking her runs along the belt

audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.1 syllables/sec, never hurried; each line one unbroken phrase in its own beat, voiceless in every other beat
audio.voices: 0.7, 4.3, 8.5 are the alpaca; 6.0 is the doll, a tinny flat wind-up toy voice
audio.lip_sync: her mouth moves on every syllable of her lines; on the doll's line her mouth is shut, the doll's mouth flaps
audio.sfx: conveyor rumble all clip, hooves drumming on every run, squeaking wheels, plastic clatter on each doll thrown in

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: she rams her hard-hatted face into the lens, eyes goggling, hammering both front hooves on the floor; camera charges in
she bolts along the belt away from the lens, hooves drumming, trolley swerving after her; camera tracks the belt
silent. She wheels on her back hooves and pelts back the other way, mane and ears flying
silent. She rears and rakes a row of dolls off the belt into the basket with both front hooves
silent. She tears back up the belt, neck low over the dolls, eyes darting tag to tag
she hauls the overstuffed doll off the belt with both front hooves and hoists it over her head; camera orbits and cranes up

she shakes the doll overhead with her whole body, neck whipping side to side, stuffing bursting from its belly; its cracked mouth flaps open and the toy voice comes out; camera cranes down to her eyes
silent. She hurls the doll over her shoulder into the basket and stamps both front hooves; camera whips right with the throw
silent. She charges the belt again and sweeps an armful of dolls in with one hoof as she runs
silent. She rears onto her back legs and stamps the pile down, the trolley sagging on its wheels
she shoves the loaded trolley into the lens with her chest, hooves scrabbling, then spreads both front hooves over the mountain of dolls and beams; camera drives in on her grin

must_appear: the alpaca the subject of every beat, eyes goggling, four hooves, her running the belt end to end, the overstuffed doll hoisted, shaken and thrown into the basket, the basket heaped over by 8.0
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, human hands, a second alpaca in frame, a fifth leg, extra limbs, duplicated limbs, deformed anatomy, malformed hooves, slow motion, static camera, the alpaca standing still, the alpaca absent from frame, the alpaca idle in her beat, an empty basket at the end, a stopped conveyor belt, accented Russian
